plugins.name: common-room
plugins.description: Turn Common Room into your GTM copilot. Research accounts and contacts, prep for calls with attendee profiles and talking points, and draft personalized outreach across email, LinkedIn, and phone. Build targeted prospect lists, generate weekly briefings for every upcoming call, and create strategic account plans — all grounded in real signal data from product usage, engagement and intent signals, so every output reflects what's actually happening in your accounts.

skills.name: account-research
skills.description: Research a company using Common Room data. Triggers on 'research [company]', 'tell me about [domain]', 'pull up signals for [account]', 'what's going on with [company]', or any account-level question.
skills.description_zh: 使用Common Room公司资料和账户信号研究企业，回答公司、域名及账户层面的问题。

skills.name: call-prep
skills.description: Prepare for a customer or prospect call using Common Room signals. Triggers on 'prep me for my call with [company]', 'prepare for a meeting with [company]', 'what should I know before talking to [company]', or any call preparation request.

skills.name: compose-outreach
skills.description: Generate personalized outreach messages using Common Room signals. Triggers on 'draft outreach to [person]', 'write an email to [name]', 'compose a message for [contact]', or any outreach drafting request.
headings: Step 2: Web Search for External Hooks (If CR Signals Are Thin)
skills.description_zh: 依据Common Room信号起草针对具体联系人定制的触达邮件或消息。

skills.name: contact-research
skills.description: Research a specific person using Common Room data. Triggers on 'who is [name]', 'look up [email]', 'research [contact]', 'is [name] a warm lead', or any contact-level question.
skills.description_zh: 使用Common Room资料研究指定个人或邮箱，了解联系人情况并判断是否为已有互动的潜在线索。

skills.name: prospect
skills.description: Build targeted account or contact lists using Common Room's Prospector. Triggers on 'find companies that match [criteria]', 'build a prospect list', 'find contacts at [type of company]', 'show me companies hiring [role]', or any list-building request.
headings: Step 3: Run the Query and Present Results

skills.description_zh: 使用Common Room Prospector按筛选条件生成目标企业或联系人名单，包括特定类型公司及招聘指定岗位的企业。

skills.name: weekly-prep-brief
skills.description: Generate a comprehensive weekly briefing for all external calls in the next 7 days. Triggers on 'weekly prep brief', 'prepare my week', 'what calls do I have this week', 'Monday prep', or any weekly planning request.
